entries.speaker: Aggressive Shadow
entries.en: Why isn't he coming back!?[n]Could something have happened!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We'll be heading right into battle when[n]we charge in there! Are you ready for this?
Perfectly ready.
Hold on a sec.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Okay, let's go!

entries.speaker: Aggressive Shadow
entries.en: Hm? Who are you!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We're here for the other key!

entries.speaker: Aggressive Shadow
entries.en: What!? Then that comm earlier...[n]How dare you!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Of course! It's better to be safe than sorry!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Perfect, we've now obtained both keys!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Oh, just one moment!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Doesn't this map have a little more[n]information than our own?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Ah, right you are! Well done, Queen!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Maybe it can tell us what the bank is like[n]further down.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: How's it look? You see where[n]the Treasure is?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well, the most suspicious area would be[n]the deepest part...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Look here. There's an elevator that leads[n]down. The Treasure must be past there.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: This map seems to indicate that the[n]area beyond the partition is rather[n]large as well...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I'm sure security will keep getting more[n]intense from here onward too. We need[n]to be careful.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: All right, we've made it so far.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Looks like there are Shadows in there.[n]Let's hide and listen in on them.

entries.speaker: Cautious Shadow
entries.en: About those intruders...

entries.speaker: Aggressive Shadow
entries.en: Oh? Are you really that concerned?

entries.speaker: Aggressive Shadow
entries.en: Don't be. We have the keys they need,[n]so things should be okay as long as we[n]protect them.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Wait... You think they're talkin' about[n]those [clr 2]two keys[clr 27]!?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm, just as expected... Those are highly[n]likely to be what opens the partition.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What're we gonna do then? Beat 'em up[n]and take the keys?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Really, Skull? Just look at 'em. They're not[n]your average Shadows.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Anyone in charge of such important keys[n]must be extremely strong.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: And there's two of them; dealing with[n]both of them would be tough. Plus,[n]they could go and sound the alarm...
What should we do?
Let's just observe for now.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hmm... That's a good question.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: They don't really look like they're goin'[n]anywhere, though...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...Then why don't we split them up and[n]beat them individually?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: And how will we do that?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Remember that monitoring room[n]upstairs—the room we got the map in?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: There was some communication[n]equipment there as well. We can[n]use that to lure one away.
That's a great idea.
That's still worrisome...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I agree. It sounds a lot safer than fighting[n]them both at the same time!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But wouldn't it be even worse if we tried[n]to take them both on at the same time?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Okay, let's leave this part to our[n]resident intellectual!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Thanks! So, first we need to head[n]to the monitoring room!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Think we should head over there now,[n]Joker?
Head straight there
